user.title: Add a Helty Flow unit
user.description:
Unit name (lowercase letters only, 1 to 10 characters; the first unit is called «master») and the unit's IP address on port 5001.

**New unit without the Air Guard app?** If the unit is not on the home Wi-Fi yet, so it has no IP, connect it first with the Prima Installazione VMC window of the master unit card (Wi-Fi icon with a cog):
1. **Very first unit**: type «master» and the IP you will reserve on the router and press Submit, then Submit again at «Unit not reachable». After the restart add the card: it is OFF-Line and the icon is under the Panic Button.
2. **Other units**: close this dialog; in the master unit card open the Impostazioni panel and press the icon.
3. In the window: «Cerca» finds the VMC_xxxxxxxx network (factory password 12345678); then type the home Wi-Fi name and password and press «Collega VMC alla Rete». Reserve a fixed IP for the MAC shown on the router.
4. Very first unit: press «Imposta questo IP nella VMC Master». Other units: do not press it; note the IP and come back here with «Add device».

It needs Home Assistant OS with Wi-Fi on the server (built-in or USB dongle); otherwise connect the unit once with the Air Guard app.

The integration creates the folder packages/vmc_helty_flow/‹name› with the VMC Master package: after restarting Home Assistant, add the «VMC Master» card from the dashboard.

data_description.host: Set a static IP for the unit in your router.

non_raggiungibile.title: Unit not reachable
non_raggiungibile.description:
The unit at {ip} does not answer on port 5001.

You can add it anyway, for example to connect it to Wi-Fi with the First Installation window of the Master card, and change the IP later from «Configure».

migra.title: Manual installation found
migra.description:
The folder packages/vmc_helty_flow/{nome} already holds a manual installation of unit {nome}.

IP entered: {ip}. IP in the manual installation: {ip_trovato}. If they differ, close this dialog and start again with the right IP.

If you continue, the folder is moved to /config/vmc_master_backup and replaced by the integration's package. Entity names stay the same, so history is kept. Before restarting, delete the hand-pasted automation (otherwise two identical automations run after the restart); after the restart, remove the old manual card.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The VMC Master package files were installed or updated: a restart is needed to load them. Press Submit to restart now.

packages_non_abilitati.title: VMC Master: packages not loaded
packages_non_abilitati.description:
The unit's files are installed but Home Assistant does not load them. configuration.yaml must contain:

homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages/

Add the line, save and restart Home Assistant.
